name: Opus Hotel Vancouver
positioning: OPUS Vancouver, a boutique lifestyle hotel in the heart of Yaletown with rooms themed around vibrant colours and pop-deco art
best_for: Travellers who want a Yaletown base steps from the Canada Line

facts.text: OPUS Vancouver is in the heart of Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood.
OPUS Vancouver is a boutique lifestyle hotel.
The rooms and suites are inspired by five lifestyle decor themes, with vibrant colours, pop-deco art and spa bathrooms.
Room bathrooms are spa-style, with heated floors and deep soaking tubs.
Deluxe Courtyard rooms overlook the inner garden and have a sitting area and a gas fireplace.
Capo, the hotel's Italian restaurant, merges Italian traditions with locally sourced ingredients for lunch, dinner and weekend brunch.
The Spritz is the hotel's cocktail bar, celebrating Italy's aperitivo culture.
The hotel is steps from the Yaletown-Roundhouse Canada Line station, which runs directly to Vancouver International Airport.
Downtown is a brisk five- to seven-minute walk away.
Opus opened in 2002 as one of the neighbourhood's first boutique hotels.
The hotel's Muses help guests find their perfect room match and plan their stay with favourite spots around the city.
OPUS Vancouver was named Top Hotel in Western Canada in the Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2026.

highlights.text: Secret Garden rooms have direct courtyard access with an outdoor patio, a gas fireplace and a four-piece spa bathroom.
The Balcony Studio has a king bed, a full-sized sitting area, a step-out balcony, a four-piece spa bathroom and a mini kitchenette.
Each suite is different, and some are certifiably quirky.
Dogs are welcome, with complimentary in-room pup tents, bowls and locally sourced treats.

considerations.text: Parking is by 24/7 secured valet in the private garage under the hotel, for an additional fee.
A pet fee of $50 per stay applies.
WhataHotel notes a compact boutique property with limited on-site amenities.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Opus Vancouver review
